import html from string import Template # Predefined HTML template with placeholders. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ $event_title
$event_title
Date: $event_date
$event_description
$additional_notes
""" def generate_event_invite(title: str, description: str, date: str, notes: str) -> str: """ Generates a secure HTML representation of an event invitation. Parameters ---------- title : str The title or name of the event. description : str A comprehensive description of the event (may include multiple paragraphs and formatting). date : str The scheduled date of the event. notes : str Any supplementary information or instructions provided by the event organizer. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string ready for secure display. """ # Sanitize each input to prevent XSS attacks safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") safe_date = html.escape(date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(notes, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") template = Template(INVITATION_FORMAT) return template.substitute( event_title=safe_title, event_description=safe_description, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes=safe_notes )
